headline: Musk's hundreds of millions in midterm spending mostly backed losing races
summary: Elon Musk poured large sums into the 2026 Republican midterm push, including $47 million from his PAC to Ken Paxton's losing Texas campaign, but most of the money went to candidates who lost. Wired puts his total midterm spending at $400 million, while Engadget reports it was nearly $500 million.
